methodSections.heading: Vegan Tinga Tacos
steps: Cut the tomatoes in half, place on a tray, season lightly, and roast for 20-25 minutes.

Heat the oil in a frypan over a medium heat. Add the onions and chipotle and cook until translucent. Add zucchini and mushrooms and cook until softened and browned, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat.

Blend the roasted tomatoes, oregano, tomato paste, garlic and achiote paste. Add this to the pan with the corn and cook at a low heat for an additional 4-5 minutes or until it thickens and the garlic smells cooked.
Add cilantro and season with salt and pepper.
Dress with vegan sour cream or guacamole.
